title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Twenty-Five thousand Pesos for the Province of Mindoro, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The sum of twenty-five thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as aid to the Province of Mindoro, to be disbursed by resolution of the
provincial board of Mindoro, in accordance with existing law.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 9, 1922.
